packs.description: Three layers — UI over State over Domain — with dependency directions the gate can check, for apps that have outgrown a single folder.
packs.guide:
# Layered Modules

Build in three layers. The UI renders state and sends intentions; it never reaches into storage or domain persistence. State modules own one area each and are the only place persistence lives. Domain code is pure: given data, it answers questions, and it imports nothing from the layers above it.

When a rule and a deadline disagree, keep the rule and say so in the plan — drift you can see is better than drift you cannot.
packs.name: Layered Modules
refactorOutline: Inventory the current folders against the pack's modules and record what is present, missing, and differently shaped.
Create the Domain layer: move pure logic out of UI and State files, fixing imports as you go.
Create the State layer: gather stores and persistence into one module per state area.
Point the UI at State only; remove direct Domain and storage imports.
Run the pack's checkable rules and fix what they flag, one rule at a time.
